details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5749-5765 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The workflow name/path whitelist only matches three canonical names and three path suffixes, so custom-named review workflows can bypass the in-flight guard.
  WHY: Consumer repos that rename both the display name and filename will not be detected, letting the empty-commit push proceed and reintroduce the stale-base race.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5712-5767 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The jq timestamp normalization can fail open on timestamp formats or empty values that `fromdateiso8601` cannot parse.
  WHY: The outer `2>/dev/null || echo ""` masks the jq error, so the guard falls through to the empty-commit path instead of blocking an in-flight run.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5721-5721 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_load_actions_runs_cached` failures or partial cache data are swallowed, and the guard operates on an empty workflow-runs blob without diagnostics.
  WHY: `2>/dev/null || echo '{"workflow_runs":[]}'` silences stderr, so cache corruption or fetch errors disable the in-flight check silently.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5743-5770 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION="retrigger_review_skipped_inflight"` introduces a new sentinel value that no existing consumer matches.
  WHY: The reviewers agree it is currently observational-only, but any exact-match or enum validation on this variable would need updating.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5745-5745 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The guard returns before the common tail that sets `STALL_RECOVERY_SHOULD_INCREMENT="true"`, so the increment flag may not propagate for skipped-inflight cases.
  WHY: The reviewer notes this is intended today, but it makes the recovery bookkeeping depend on callers not relying on that variable.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5712-5771 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: There is a TOCTOU window between the in-flight check and the empty-commit push.
  WHY: A new `review_autofix` run can start after the jq filter but before `git push`, so the stale-base gate is still bypassed in that narrow window.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:1565-1566 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The mock returns success even when the nested `jq` call fails, so malformed jq expressions collapse to empty output instead of failing the test.
  WHY: Both reviewers note that `p.stdout` is written unconditionally, which can mask jq parse errors.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:1551-1574 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The test mock imports `subprocess` mid-function / inside a conditional path.
  WHY: This is a test-harness hygiene issue that makes the dependency resolution happen at execution time instead of import time.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:1563-1570 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `--jq` mock path bypasses the ETag/status/304 logic used elsewhere in the `/actions/runs` mock.
  WHY: As a result, supplemental queued/completed fetches do not exercise production-like error and 304 paths under test.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5721-5721 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback `_rtr_inflight_blob="$(_load_actions_runs_cached 2>/dev/null || echo '{"workflow_runs":[]}')"` discards stderr, so cache corruption or partial data is silently treated as an empty run list.
  WHY: The guard then operates on potentially stale/incorrect data without diagnostics.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5712-5771 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: There is a TOCTOU race between the guard's check and the empty-commit push.
  WHY: A `review_autofix` run can start after the jq filter but before `git push`, so the empty commit still lands and invalidates the in-flight run's stale-base gate.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5755-5756 | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The timestamp normalization can fail if GitHub changes the timestamp suffix format.
  WHY: `fromdateiso8601` fails on non-`Z` timestamps, and the wrapper masks it so the guard falls open.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5770-5770 | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: `retrigger_review_skipped_inflight` is added as a new `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION` sentinel but has no consumer.
  WHY: The variable is only observability metadata and does not affect routing.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5750-5765 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The workflow name/path filter is incomplete; it only checks three explicit names and three explicit path suffixes.
  WHY: Consumer repos with differently named review workflows or renamed workflow files will slip past this guard and can still invalidate the stale-base gate.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:1565-1565 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The mock exits with code 0 even if the nested `jq` call fails.
  WHY: When jq fails, `p.stdout` is empty and the script still exits 0, so the test can pass for the wrong reason instead of failing explicitly.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5724-5752 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The jq timestamp normalization can fail on certain GitHub API timestamp formats.
  WHY: If jq cannot parse the timestamp, the guard silently falls back via `2>/dev/null || echo ""` to the legacy empty-commit path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5721-5721 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback `_load_actions_runs_cached 2>/dev/null || echo '{"workflow_runs":[]}'` discards stderr.
  WHY: Any cache corruption or malformed JSON is silently treated as empty data, so the guard operates without diagnostic output.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5743-5743 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION="retrigger_review_skipped_inflight"` sentinel value has no matching consumer case in existing logic.
  WHY: It is logged but nothing reads or acts on this specific value, so it is currently observability-only.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5712-5767 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The jq timestamp normalization regex is potentially unsafe for some ISO8601 timestamps and can silently fail.
  WHY: `sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z")` assumes a specific format; if that assumption is wrong, the pipeline produces empty output and the guard falls open without warning.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:1556-1556 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Importing `subprocess` mid-function inside a conditional branch.
  WHY: It defers dependency resolution to runtime on that path, making failures harder to diagnose.
=== END FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===

(No findings reported.)

  PROBLEM: The workflow-filter whitelist only matches three display names and three path suffixes.
  WHY: Custom-named review workflows are not caught, so the guard can fall through and the empty commit can invalidate the stale-base gate.

  WHY: The outer `2>/dev/null || echo ""` masks the error and the guard falls open.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5767-5770 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `return 1` inside the case branch skips the later `STALL_RECOVERY_SHOULD_INCREMENT="true"` tail, and the new sentinel value has no consumer.
  WHY: The reviewer notes the return is currently harmless but the new exact-match value is purely observational and would need future whitelisting if consumed.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:1563-1570 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new `--jq` mock path bypasses the ETag/status/304 logic.
  WHY: Supplemental `_safe_gh_jq` fetches never see production-like 304 or error cases.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:1565-1566 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The mock runs `jq` and writes `p.stdout` unconditionally even if `jq` fails.
  WHY: A malformed expression becomes empty output with success, masking parse errors.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:1563-1570 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `subprocess` is imported inside the mock path.
  WHY: The dependency is resolved at execution time in test code instead of at import time.

  WHY: The reviewer notes this may make skipped-inflight bookkeeping depend on callers not relying on that variable.

  PROBLEM: The new sentinel value `retrigger_review_skipped_inflight` is not documented or consumed by any existing consumer.
  WHY: It is harmless today because it is observational only, but future exact-match consumers would need updating.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:1551-1574 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `subprocess` is imported inside the conditional mock branch.
  WHY: This is a hygiene issue that defers the import to runtime in test execution.
